datafield.subfield: songs by Rabindranath Tagore ; woodcuts by Karen Kunc
196 x 18 cm folded to 21 x 18 cm
"These prose translations were made by Rabindranath Tagore from his original Bengali songs published in 1913 ..."--Colophon.

"The text is 11 point Romulus, printed on a Vandercook SP15. The paper is Japanese Nishinouchi, and the woodblocks are birch ... The production was greatly assisted by intern Amy Hutchinson ... This bookwork is published by Blue Heron Press, in an edition of 50 impressions ..."--Colophon.

Text is letterpress with reduction woodcut images by Karen Kunc. Printed on one side of a long sheet consisting of several sheets glued together and folded to form pages. The unfolded book creates a wave with a series of flower images. Laid in case (22 x 22 cm.) with a tray formed by balsa wood sides. The case is covered in paper resembling shagreen. The title and the artist's name are embossed with graphite rubbed over to reveal the letters.
